g.text: Test set, headline runs (320 runs, 2092 windows). The rule (Model 0) flags a window when any service's p95 is above 2x its baseline or its 5xx share above 5%.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Margins are paired: both detectors are scored on the same resampled runs. Healthy windows = windows with no fault active.
